entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: mixed operand is not admitted for %s at %s
entries.rationale: every consumer cites a (family, site) row the table holds and names the payload rule that row carries, checked through requireMixedOperandPolicy and requireMixedPlanPolicy; TestMixedOperandPolicyControlsActualDispatch proves each row load-bearing in both directions and TestMixedOperandPolicyAdmissionInventory pins the row set, and the two closed dispatchers that can request the fail-closed sentinel (prepareMixedAggregatePlan, executeMixedSelectorPolicy) enumerate every aggregate family mixedAggregateFamily maps. The not-admitted error is therefore reachable only by editing the table or a consumer's literal, never from a wire query.
